[SWS_J1939Dcm_00155]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386
⌈If the configuration parameter J1939DcmDevErrorDetect is enabled, the function
J1939Dcm_StartOfReception shall check if the J1939Dcm is the right state to
receive a command message over TP protocol.
In case of an error, the function
J1939Dcm_StartOfReception shall return with BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK without any ef-
fect, and shall report the runtime error J1939DCM_E_INVALID_STATE.⌋
